title: Files, Folders, File Extensions ar Paths
learningObjectives: Files ar Folders do Project mit kana bhala bhabete sajaw kana ta bojhaw dareyag kana.
File Extension chinaw kate ona cinij janaw kana ar cinij nischit banaw kana ta bojhaw dareyag kana.
Folder Tree parhaw kate Relative Path ar Absolute Path reak bhed bojhaw dareyag kana.
Web Project sajaw lagi sapha nam ar thik Paths babohar dareyag kana.

understand.concept: File do khobor sambhaw reak mit jinis kana. Ona re Text, Image, Video ba Program Code menak dare kana. Folder ke Directory men kana. Ona bhitri re Files ar arho Folders thaw dare kana. Ek kaj ba ek bisoy saote jukto Files mit Folder re thaw kate Project ke sajaw thaw dare kana. Mit File ba Folder okare menak ta chinaw reak thikana ke Path men kana. File Name reak ses re menak `.html`, `.css`, `.js`, `.png` leka ongso ke File Extension men kana. Ona sadharan te File reak Format ba babohar reak sanket de kana. Kintu Extension khali dek kate File bhitri reak asol Content nischit banaw dare kana.
understand.whyItMatters: Mit Web Project re HTML Pages, CSS Stylesheets, JavaScript Files, Images, Fonts ar arho Resources menak dare kana. Ona ko thik Folders re thaw kate thik Paths dile Browser ar Developer Tools darkar Files khoj dare kana. Ona te Code bojhaw, bhul khoj, Project sambhaw ar bad re nutun Features jogaw sahaj kana. Path ba File Name bhul akana khan CSS lagaw ban, JavaScript Load ban ba Image udub ban kana.
understand.history: Purana Computer File Systems reho khobor ke nam menak Files re sambhaw kate Directories ba Folders re sajaw thaw leka calaw akana. Pichhe File Name reak ses re Extension lagaw kate File Type chinaw reak riti sadharan akana. Dher Operating Systems Extension dek kate File cin Application re khulaw ta thik kana. Kintu nutun Systems File bhitri reak Content o check dare kana. Ona lagi `.jpg` nam menak khan o ona asol Image File kana ta nischit ban kana.
understand.analogy: Mit school Library reak udaharan bhabna me. Pura Library do mit Project leka. Pustak ko bisoy anusar alag shelf ba section re thaw do Folders leka. Mit pustak do mit File leka. Pustak okare shelf ar section re menak ta janaw khobor do Path leka. Pustak reak Label bisoy reak sanket de kana, kintu Label khali dek kate bhitri cinij purna janaw ban dare kana. File Extension o emon sanket kana.
understand.analogyLimit: Digital Folder do asol shelf ban kana; ona Computer bhitri Files sajaw thaw reak Logical Location kana. Path re Folder Name, File Name ar ona majhi reak Separators thik thakna darkar. Alag Folders re ek nam reak Files menak dare kana. Ona alag chinaw lagi pura Path darkar kana.

explain.narrative:
Ona Project Tree bhalo kate nel me:

`my-site/` do main Project Folder kana. Ona bhitri `index.html` menak kana. `css/` Folder bhitri `styles.css`, `js/` bhitri `app.js`, ar `images/` bhitri `logo.png` menak kana.

**Folder Tree kemte parhaw?** Mit Folder reak niche sedikit dahina side saraw nam ko ona Folder bhitri reak jinis udub kana. `css/`, `js/`, `images/` tin alag Folders kana. Project reak main Folder ke Project Root men kana. Project Root khon Logo File talak Path do `images/logo.png` kana. Web example re `/` chinha Folder Names alag kana.

**Relative Path:** Mit nirdharit Base Location saote tulna kate ar File okare menak ta udub kana. `index.html` Project Root re menak khan, `css/styles.css` reak mane Root khon `css` Folder bhitri calaw kate `styles.css` khoj. HTML Page arho Subfolder re menak khan Path badlaw darkar. `../` babohar kate bartaman Folder khon mit star upar reak Folder re calaw kana.

**Absolute Path:** File System reak Root ba nirdharit Root Location khon File reak pura thikana udub kana. Ona reak rup Operating System anusar badlaw kana. Windows re `C:\\Users\\Student\\my-site\\index.html` leka Path menak dare kana. Web URL re `/css/styles.css` Website Root khon ganana Root-relative Path hoy dare kana. File System Absolute Path ar Website Root-relative URL ek jinis ban kana.

**HTML re Path babohar:** Project Root re menak `index.html` re `<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/styles.css">` ol khan Browser Document reak Base URL anusar `css` Folder re Stylesheet khoj kana. HTML Page ar Folder re menak khan Path badlaw dare kana.

**Nam thaw reak niyam:** Spelling, Uppercase ar Lowercase akhor thik milaw darkar. Dher Web Servers re `Logo.png` ar `logo.png` alag File Names kana. Chhota, sapha ar artha menak nam babohar me. Spaces ar ajib chinha ko bachaw me; darkar khan sabda majhi hyphen babohar me, jemn `my-profile.html`.

examples.code:
my-site/
├── index.html
├── css/
│   └── styles.css
├── js/
│   └── app.js
└── images/
    └── logo.png

practise.guidedTask: Upar reak Project Tree babohar kate `index.html` khon `js/app.js` ar `images/logo.png` talak Relative Paths ol me. CSS File reak asol nam `styles.css` kana ta bhabna me. Jodi `css/style.css` Path de khan Browser File cet lagi ban khoj dare? Folder Name ar File Name reak bhed bojhaw me.
practise.independentTask: Mit chhota Profile Website lagi Folder Tree banaw me. Ona re mit HTML Page, mit CSS File, mit JavaScript File ar do Images thaw me. Ona ko thik Folders re thaw me. Pichhe `index.html` menak Folder ke base kate prottek Resource lagi thik Relative Path ol me.
hints: Relative Path ganana karte HTML Page menak Folder ke suru jagah manaw me. URL `/` khon suru khan Website Root khon ganana kana.
Har Folder Name ar File Name reak Spelling, Uppercase/Lowercase ar Extension check me.
`../` reak mane bartaman Folder khon mit star upar reak Folder re calaw.
File Extension sadharan sanket kana; ona File bhitri reak Content nischit banaw kana.

questions.prompt: `my-site/index.html` khon `my-site/css/styles.css` File talak calaw reak thik Relative Path cin kana?
questions.explanation: `index.html` Project Root re menak kana ar `css` Folder o ona Root re menak kana. Ona lagi `css/` Folder bhitri calaw kate ona bhitri `styles.css` khoj darkar.

questions.prompt: File Extension sadharan te cin janaw kana?
options: File bhitri cinij ke hamesa nischit kate udub kana.
File reak Format ba babohar reak sadharan sanket de kana.
File cin Folder re menak ta janaw kana.
questions.answer: File reak Format ba babohar reak sadharan sanket de kana.
questions.explanation: Extension do sadharan Naming Convention kana. File Name bhul sanket de dare kana ar System bhitri reak Content check dare kana.
